crossing: first complete target-0 then target-1 iteration at or above each label; charge exact uniform initialization and retain overshoot

decision.inconclusive: other complete outcome; failed source, compute or numerical gate stops with retained evidence
decision.negative: B8 fails any absolute gate, medium/dry paired median >= +0.001, or low/wet paired median > +0.001
decision.positive: at final 10m linear average B8 passes both spots' unchanged absolute gates, medium/dry paired median <= -0.001 initial pots and low/wet paired median <= +0.001

diagnostics: both-seat additive saved-prefix best-response-loss contributions at preselected medium/dry exact turn rows 2443, 1596, 14 and river rows 1806, 640, plus aggregate turn/river rows; report saved probabilities, reach, alternative-action values, fixed opponent and optimal reply continuation assumptions; diagnostic only
paired_metric: candidate B8 minus published control B4 at each matched work crossing for each seed; report all three final differences and median per known spot
primary_metric: exact restricted-game NashConv/2 exploitability divided by initial pot; lower is better

prior_compute_context.interpretation: planning context only, not a B8 timing or admission; fixed new three-repeat B8 profile and strict forecast decide admission

profile.forecast: for each of six candidate spot/seed paths take maximum of three complete construction-through-replay whole times scaled by 10m/actual work; sum these six maxima in fixed index-modulo-three worker partitions; T=max sum; require strict 2*(2*T+600)<7200

publication: prospective protocol before new B8 outcomes; isolated tested source with exact-source local base/optional/hooks/hosted qualification; publish and byte-verify synthetic proof, 18-path three-repeat 100k profile and separate compute admission before one own candidate run; publish own raw B8 policies before comparison-only native audit; final exact-source checks and solo review
question: At matched 10m charged node work, does batch-eight signed external sampling reduce the known medium/dry turn/river exploitability versus the immutable published batch-four signed control without degrading the known low/wet spot?
reference: pinned OpenSpiel 2.0.2 Apache-2.0 comparison-only scalar audit of new candidate policies; published control's prior audit is reused by exact receipt; no reference strategy enters training
stop_rule: one fixed six-path matched-work B8 candidate run against immutable published B4 controls; retain complete/partial/failing results; no seed search, unfavorable B8 retry, B16 follow-on as a favorable search, budget or threshold change, default promotion or unseen generalization claim
training: six independent candidate paths, one per known spot and seed; same RNG seed within each control/candidate pair but batch sizes consume different random draws; no saved-policy warm start
